column3: [imports] test-suite/corpus/pycsl-reference/qa70.py: the imported function `val1` of `qa70.py` has the same name as a function the program defines itself: pycsl gives every function ONE WhyML name, so one of the two definitions would be dropped and a call meant for it (a module-qualified `mod.val1()`, or the dependency's own call of it) would be verified against the other one's contract, while CPython runs each module's own function (routes #624 / #625: `import lib` beside a local `def val1`, or two libraries that both define it). FIX: rename one of the two functions, or import it under a distinct name (`from mod import val1 as other`).
